decision: verified within requested source, QA and visual supporting scope

source_review.source_delta: Only aria-keyshortcuts="Alt+n" and one document keydown handler added to index.html; existing IDs, labels, handlers, layout, tokens and form behavior preserved.
source_review.shortcut_boundary: Actual UI shortcut focuses New todo, prevents default, excludes Ctrl/Meta/composition and does not escape an open confirmation dialog.
source_review.safe_execution_review: No network APIs, storage, dependencies, external resources or arbitrary code execution introduced. Implementer qa.py was inspected as source and was not executed.

independent_qa.content_provenance: Each fresh context navigated to a synthetic loopback review URL; document route fulfilled only immutable index.html bytes matching the recorded hash; all other page requests aborted.
checked: Shortcut after add does not resubmit
Alt+n preserves Cancel and Confirm focus inside modal
Escape and cancel restore focus and preserve row
Overflow in light and dark themes

observations: All three supplied dark screenshots show readable neutral fixture controls with no horizontal clipping; 320px stacks input and Add while wider viewports retain an inline form.
Fresh dark screenshots show one checked milk row, submissions=1 and the visible New todo focus outline at each viewport.
Fresh 320px modal screenshot shows both dialog actions contained within the viewport and visible Cancel focus.
Fresh 320px light screenshot shows readable preserved labels and boundaries, unclipped controls, and the empty state after confirmed clear.

critique_review.assessment: Preservation and shortcut/modal claims agree with the source diff and independent interaction evidence. The stated browser/OS interception limitation is appropriate. Implementer PASS is supporting provenance only, not the independent verdict.

limitations: This is a narrow review of the requested shortcut and preserved fixture; no broad product acceptance is asserted.
No screen-reader or real operating-system keyboard integration test; Playwright dispatches browser keyboard input.
IME composition exclusion was inspected statically, not exercised using a real IME.
Supplied screenshots depict a later loaded row and cannot by themselves prove milk checkbox completion; fresh independent screenshots provide that evidence.
The connected Firefox broker is outside the outer OS sandbox; the reviewer restricted all page requests, but no claim is made about browser background traffic.
